App.Description: Virtual machines on Apple silicon: the engine of Machines' VMs

Installs.Fetches:
set -euo pipefail
d="$HOME/.local/share"
case "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-}" in /*) d="$XDG_DATA_HOME" ;; esac
mkdir -p "$d/station/vms" "$HOME/.local/bin"
new=$(mktemp -d "$d/station/tart.new.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$new"' EXIT
curl -fsSL https://github.com/cirruslabs/tart/releases/latest/download/tart.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$new"
fresh=$("$new/tart.app/Contents/MacOS/tart" --version)
now=$("$d/station/tart/tart.app/Contents/MacOS/tart" --version 2>/dev/null || true)
[ "$fresh" != "$now" ] || exit 0
old="$d/station/tart.old.$$"
[ ! -e "$d/station/tart" ] || mv "$d/station/tart" "$old"
mv "$new" "$d/station/tart" || { [ ! -e "$old" ] || mv "$old" "$d/station/tart"; exit 1; }
rm -rf "$old"

set -eu
case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; *) echo "no build for $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
version=$(curl -fsSL https://checkpoint-api.hashicorp.com/v1/check/terraform | sed -n 's/.*"current_version":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
[ -n "$version" ] || { echo "the latest release did not answer" >&2; exit 1; }
base=https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/$version
zip=terraform_${version}_linux_$arch.zip
dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$dir"' EXIT
curl -fsSL -o "$dir/$zip" "$base/$zip"
curl -fsSL -o "$dir/sums" "$base/terraform_${version}_SHA256SUMS"
(cd "$dir" && grep " $zip\$" sums | sha256sum -c -)
python3 -c 'import sys, zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]).extract("terraform", sys.argv[2])' "$dir/$zip" "$dir"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
install -m 0755 "$dir/terraform" "$HOME/.local/bin/terraform"
